summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes 727KB obfuscated payload
details: This package (advertised as a Vue file-browser/content-builder renderer component) declares a preinstall hook `node setup.mjs` that, when no local `bun` binary is present, downloads the Bun runtime zip for the installer's platform/architecture from oven-sh's GitHub releases, unpacks it to a temp directory, chmods the binary executable, and then invokes `bun <pkg>/math_init.js` on install. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB heavily obfuscated file at the tarball root (shuffled string-array with a `push(shift())` rotator, integer-encoded string table, hex-mangled identifiers, custom decoder over a mixed alphabet, `@bun @bun-cjs` header). The file is not listed in `package.json`'s declared `files` array (which enumerates only `dist` and `src`), so it is smuggled into the tarball outside the author-declared manifest. Executing an opaque obfuscated blob under a freshly downloaded alternate runtime bears no relation to a Vue UI component's declared purpose and evades Node-based scanners. Result: arbitrary attacker-controlled code executes on the installer's machine automatically on `npm install`.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
